# e2e_blockstorage (Resource)

Provides an E2E Block Storage (volume) resource.
This resource allows you to manage block storage volumes on your E2E infrastructure. When applied, a new block storage volume is created. When destroyed, the volume is removed.

~> **Migration Notice**: This resource has parameter changes in v3.0.0. See the [v3.0.0 Upgrade Guide](../guides/upgrade-to-v3.md#affected-resources) for migration instructions.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "e2e_blockstorage" "volume1" {
  name       = "data-volume"
  region     = "Delhi NCR"  # Use 'region' instead of deprecated 'location'
  project_id = "12345"      # Use quoted string for project_id
  size       = 250          # GB
}
```

## Import

Block storage volumes can be imported using the following format:

```
terraform import e2e_blockstorage.example project_id/region/block_storage_id
```

For example:

```
terraform import e2e_blockstorage.volume1 "12345/Delhi NCR/67890"
```

~> **Note**: The `name` field is immutable after block storage creation. Changing the name will trigger a recreation of the resource.

~> **Note**: The `size` field can be increased (upgraded) but cannot be decreased. Size upgrades are only allowed when the block storage is attached to a node.

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the block storage, also acts as its unique ID. **Immutable**: This field cannot be changed after block storage creation. Changing it will trigger resource recreation.
- `region` (String) Region where the block storage will be created. This is the standard parameter name for specifying the deployment location. **Immutable**: This field cannot be changed after block storage creation.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project as a string (e.g., `"12345"`). **Note**: Changed from integer to string in v2.x with numeric validation. Terraform auto-converts unquoted integers, but we recommend quoting for consistency. To find the project id, please refer to our [`API Documentation`](https://docs.e2enetworks.com/api/myaccount/#/paths/pbac-projects-header/get). **Immutable**: This field cannot be changed after block storage creation.
- `size` (Number) Size of the block storage in GB. Choose from: {250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, 24000}. **Upgradable**: The size can be increased after creation but cannot be decreased. Size upgrades are only allowed when the block storage is attached to a node.
- `location` (Optional, **Deprecated**) (String) **DEPRECATED**: Use 'region' instead. This parameter will be removed in version 3.0.0. Location where the block storage will be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `iops` (String) Input/Output Operations Per Second for the block storage, automatically calculated based on size.
- `status` (String) status (String): Current status of the block storage.
- `vm_id` (String) ID of the VM to which the block storage is attached.
- `vm_name` (String) Name of the VM to which the block storage is attached.
